title: BUGFIX — wire edge-tts into produce-vlog.ts TTS backbone
rationale: Sprint TICKET-009-Q01-02 updated tts-voiceover.ts with edge-tts fallback, but produce-vlog.ts has its own inline TTS in generateTTSBackbone() that only has ElevenLabs → macOS say. When ElevenLabs quota is exhausted (as it is), TTS backbone falls to macOS say. If macOS say produces silent/small audio, the 06:00 run fails has_audio. Fix: add edge-tts as intermediate fallback in produce-vlog.ts generateTTSBackbone(), matching the tts-voiceover.ts pattern.
success_criteria: generateTTSBackbone uses edge-tts when ElevenLabs fails/not set
No new imports beyond execSync (already imported)

tasks.description: produce-vlog.ts generateTTSBackbone(): add edge-tts fallback between ElevenLabs and macOS say
